title: Site ignores my dark mode setting
what_happened: My computer is set to dark mode, as it always is at night, but the site came up bright white. There's a "Switch to dark mode" button, so they have a dark theme, it just didn't follow my setting.
expected: Since the site has a dark theme, it should open in dark when my system asks for dark.

title: Cookie banner sits right over the leader's bio
what_happened: The cookie box floats in the middle of the bottom of the screen and covers most of Amber Baird's bio text, the exact thing I came to read. It follows me as I scroll.
expected: A banner tucked to a corner or a thin bar at the bottom that doesn't cover the content.

title: Bios name no employers, clients or dates I can check
what_happened: Both principals are named with photos, which is good. But Jimmy's "Previously" just says "Large transformation program and team buildouts", no company named. Amber's says "a UPS logistics startup" without naming it. No LinkedIn links either, so I can't verify anything before tomorrow's call.
expected: Named past employers or roles with years, or a LinkedIn link, so I could check the background before putting my practice's name next to theirs.

title: Case studies promised but the page is empty
what_happened: Resources says "Case studies, articles, and perspectives", then "No articles published yet. Check back soon." Nowhere on the site did I find a single named client, project outcome, number or date. That's exactly my worry: a polished site with nothing behind it.
expected: At least one or two short, real examples (even anonymised: industry, size, what changed, when), or else don't put "Case Studies" in the nav and heading until there are some.
